operations.result: The owner's read, the unsigned refusal and a stranger's refusal were compared; all three differ.

evidence.scope: Signed GET by the owner of a draft standard collection.
Signed GET by a wallet with no role on the draft.

gaps: Owner read: the node omits salt, managers, minters, reviewed_at, forum_link, forum_id, lock, linked_contract_address, linked_contract_network, is_mapping_complete and item_count, adds third_party_id, answers created_at and updated_at as epoch milliseconds instead of ISO strings, and answers contract_address and urn as null: its schema cannot store the contract address upstream computes for a draft.
Unsigned request: upstream answers 401 with {ok:false, data:{message}, error:'Unauthenticated'}; the node answers 400 with {ok:false, error, message} and no data.
Stranger: both answer 401, but upstream's body is {ok:false, data:{id, eth_address}, error:'Unauthorized'} and the node's is {ok:false, error:'Unauthorized', message:'Unauthorized'}.
operations.remaining_verification: Capture reads by the committee, an on-chain manager, a third-party manager and any signer of a published collection, and a missing id.

operations.result: The owner's creation of a standard draft was compared; the node creates it and answers a different body.

evidence.scope: Signed PUT by the owner creating a new standard draft with a client-shaped body (eth_address set to the signer, data set). created_at and updated_at come from the database clock and are volatile.

gaps: Create: upstream stores the salt and the contract address it computes from the id and data and answers them with the collection urn; the node answers contract_address and urn as null and omits salt, managers, minters, reviewed_at, forum_link, forum_id, lock, linked_contract_address, linked_contract_network, is_mapping_complete and item_count, and adds third_party_id. The timestamps are volatile in this capture, so their format is compared by the owner read of GET /v1/collections/:id.
operations.remaining_verification: Capture an update of an existing draft, a third-party collection, a locked and a published collection (423 and 409 upstream), a name already in use, a stranger's write and mismatched body and URL ids.
